description: The VECTOR(FLOAT|INT, n) column type: declaration, storage round-trip for both element types, and DESCRIBE rendering the type. Converted 1:1 from features/VectorTypeTest (now retired); its assertNotNull on the stored cell is expressed as an IS NOT NULL projection.

steps.sql: CREATE TABLE vt_f (id INTEGER, emb VECTOR(FLOAT, 3))
SELECT emb FROM vt_f WHERE id = 1
SELECT IFF(emb IS NULL, 'null', 'set') FROM vt_f WHERE id = 1
CREATE TABLE vt_i (id INTEGER, v VECTOR(INT, 2))
SELECT IFF(v IS NULL, 'null', 'set') FROM vt_i
